label: D-Bartack
description: The D-shaped bartack is a half-moon or D-profile reinforcement stitch placed at the top corners of a pocket opening, its curved outer edge following the stress line where the pocket mouth meets the face cloth. The D-form distributes tension across a larger arc than a linear bar tack, making it particularly effective on heavier cloths and working pockets subject to repeated use. In bespoke tailoring it is regarded as a refined functional detail that, because of its decorative curved shape, is visible and intentional without looking merely utilitarian.
